description: Popis javnih pješačkih površina is a dataset listed in Open Data Portal Croatia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grad Ivanec. list of public pedestrian areas with information on the type, area, final layer, cadastre, ownership and manager, according to the Law on Communal Economy - records of communal infrastructure. Coverage: Grad Ivanec. The portal shows the English title as "List of public pedestrian areas" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grad Ivanec. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://data.gov.hr/otvorena-dozvola). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-portal-otvorenih-podataka.
